answer: Because the ridge stake is held until the nectar settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the nebula audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 20% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A farm running 41 keys as a result forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation inexpensive. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
